page.title: Servers
page.subtitle_one: {{formatted}} server · each keeps its own accounts, chats and settings
page.subtitle_other: {{formatted}} servers · each keeps its own accounts, chats and settings
page.subtitleNone: Other Claudios this one drives. Each keeps its own accounts, chats and settings.

off.title: Servers are off
off.body: Turn them on to drive other Claudios from this one. While they are off nothing connects and no credential is used; what you add is kept.

none.title: No other server yet
none.body: Pair another Claudio to drive it from here: with the code its own Servers page shows, or with an owner token for one that has no screen.

servers.needs-pairing: Its token was revoked or is no longer accepted.
servers.identity-changed: The machine at its address is not the one that was paired.
servers.needs-update: Its version does not fit this one.
servers.fingerprint-mismatch: Its certificate is not the one that was pinned.
servers.redirect-refused: It answered with a redirect, which is never followed.

add.title: Add a server
add.codeIntro: On the other Claudio open Servers, then “Let another Claudio connect to this one”, and show a code. It lasts 5 minutes and works once.
add.tokenIntro: For a Claudio with no screen, or one behind a sign-in. Paste an owner token of the other Claudio: it is used once to get a token of its own for this one, and then forgotten.
add.addressesHint: How to reach it, in the order to try. Add a Tailscale name or a tunnel as another way in.
add.codeHint: Eight characters, with or without the space.
add.name: Name
add.nameHint: How it appears in the selector.

addresses.invalid: Not an address Claudio can reach: use a host name or IP, with a port if it is not 443.

confirm.title: Compare this certificate
confirm.body: Before the token leaves this Claudio, check that the address shows the certificate of the Claudio you mean. On that one, open Settings, Access and safety, and read the fingerprint of its local network card.
confirm.typed: Paste the fingerprint from the other Claudio to check it here
confirm.typedHint: Optional: it tells you if the two do not match.
confirm.authority: This address is a name a public authority signed (Tailscale or a tunnel), so its fingerprint is not the one on the local network card. What is checked is the certificate of that name, and that the Claudio answering is the one you mean.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.newAddressNote: A new address has to prove it is the same server before it is saved.

servers.needs-pairing: Its token is no longer accepted.
servers.identity-changed: It is not the server that was paired.
servers.needs-update: Its version does not fit this one.

terminal.needs-tunnel: Its terminal is closed to other Claudios by its own setting.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: This Claudio gives back its token on {{name}} so it stops working there, then forgets the server. {{name}} and everything on it are not touched.
remove.forceBody: The token could not be revoked on {{name}}, so it may still work there until it is revoked from that Claudio's own Servers page (Connected hubs). Remove it from this list anyway?
remove.doneUnrevoked: Removed {{name}}, but its token may still work there

pairAgain.title: Pair {{name}} again
pairAgain.body: Its identity changed or its token was revoked. Pairing again keeps its name, colour and addresses, and replaces the token. Check it is the Claudio you mean before you do.
pairAgain.doneOldKept: {{name}} is paired again; its earlier token could not be revoked
pairAgain.bodyIdentity: The machine at its address is not the one that was paired, so it may have been reinstalled. Pairing again keeps its name, colour and addresses, and replaces the token. Check it is the Claudio you mean first.
pairAgain.bodyToken: Its token was revoked or is no longer accepted. Pairing again keeps its name, colour and addresses, and replaces the token.

update.title: Update {{name}}?
update.body: {{name}} will install the newer Claudio. The server restarts to finish, and its own work is not interrupted until you restart it.
update.failed: Could not start the update of {{name}}

connect.title: Let another Claudio connect to this one
connect.body: To drive this Claudio from another, show a code here and type it in the other one's “Add a server”.
connect.once: It works once. A new code voids this one.
connect.noFingerprint: Listening on the local network is off, so there is no certificate to compare. A Tailscale or tunnel address is checked by its own certificate.
connect.authRequired: Another Claudio can only connect to one that asks for a sign-in. Turn on a token or OIDC in Access first.

hubs.title: Connected hubs
hubs.none: No other Claudio is connected to this one.
hubs.revokeBody: {{name}} can no longer drive this Claudio. It can pair again with a new code.
hubs.failed: Could not read the connected hubs
hubs.notOwner: Only the owner can see which Claudios are connected to this one.

offline.title: {{name}} cannot be reached
offline.body: This Claudio could not reach {{name}} at <mono>{{address}}</mono>. It may be off, asleep or on another network.
offline.bodyNoAddress: This Claudio could not reach {{name}} at any of its addresses. It may be off, asleep or on another network.

needsUpdate.title: {{name}} needs an update
needsUpdate.remoteOld: {{name}} runs Claudio {{remote}}, older than this Claudio can drive. Update {{name}}, then come back.
needsUpdate.localOld: {{name}} runs Claudio {{remote}}, newer than this Claudio understands. Update this Claudio, then come back.
needsUpdate.unknown: {{name}} runs a version of Claudio this one cannot drive.

behind.text: {{name}} runs Claudio {{remote}} and this Claudio runs {{local}}: what {{name}} added since does not show here until you update this Claudio.

servers.already-paired: That server is on the list already.
servers.unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check that the other Claudio is running and on this network.
servers.not-claudio: Something answered at that address, but not a Claudio.
servers.bad-answer: That server answered more than a Claudio would, so nothing was kept.
servers.token-invalid: That server does not take this token. Paste an owner token of that server.
servers.address-invalid: One of the addresses is not an address.
servers.address-insecure: Plain HTTP would carry the token in the clear. Use https://, or http:// only for this machine.
servers.address-refused: One of the addresses is not allowed: a server is reached on the network, never through this machine's own services.
servers.address-identity: One address answers as a different Claudio from the others.
servers.fingerprint-mismatch: The certificate shown is not the one that server says is its own. Something between the two answered in its place, so nothing was paired.
servers.fingerprint-unexpected: The address now shows a different certificate from the one you confirmed, so the token was not sent.
servers.identity-changed: The server that answered is not the one that was paired, so nothing was changed.
servers.too-many: This Claudio already keeps as many servers as it can. Remove one first.
servers.disabled: Servers are off. Turn them on first.

server-links.code-invalid: The other Claudio does not take that code: it may be mistyped, used or expired. Show a new one there.
server-links.too-many: Too many tries. Wait a moment, then try again.
server-links.auth-required: The other Claudio asks for no sign-in, so it cannot be paired. Turn on a token there first.

localName.title: This server
localName.label: Name
localName.hint: How this Claudio names itself in its server selector.
